description: Master the art of numeric fusion! Slide, match, and multiply tiles in this addictive 4x4 puzzle challenge. Can you reach the legendary 2048 tile?
instructions: Use your arrow keys or swipe gestures to shift all tiles on the board. When two tiles with the same value collide, they merge into one. Strategize your moves to keep the board from filling up!

title: Snake
description: The ultimate classic returns with a neon twist. Guide your serpent through the digital void, consuming pixels to grow while avoiding the inevitable collision with your own tail.
instructions: Use Arrow Keys or WASD to control your snake's direction. Consume the glowing apples to increase your score and length. Be careful: the faster you grow, the harder it is to navigate!

title: Tetris
description: Experience the world's most famous block-stacking puzzle. Arrange falling tetrominoes to clear horizontal lines and prevent the stack from reaching the top. How high can you score?
instructions: Left/Right Arrows to move blocks, Up Arrow to rotate, Down Arrow to soft drop. Use the Spacebar for a hard drop. Clear multiple lines at once for a massive score boost!

title: Pong
description: Where it all began. Relive the original table tennis simulation. Simple, fast-paced, and eternally competitive. Test your reflexes against our orbital AI.
instructions: Use your mouse, touch, or Arrow Keys to move your paddle. Deflect the ball past the AI's defense to score. The ball speed increases as the rally continues!

title: Breakout
description: Shatter the barriers! Control your paddle to bounce the ball and destroy a wall of colorful bricks. Collect power-ups and keep the ball in play in this arcade staple.
instructions: Slide your mouse or finger to move the paddle left and right. Keep the ball bouncing upward to clear the brick layout. Don't let the ball fall off the bottom of the screen!

title: Minesweeper
description: De-fuse the tension! Use logic and deduction to clear a grid hidden with deadly mines. This classic Windows puzzle requires a sharp mind and careful clicks.
instructions: Left-click to reveal a square. Right-click (or long press) to flag a potential mine. The numbers revealed indicate how many mines are touching that specific square.

title: Tic Tac Toe
description: The perfect quick-fire challenge. Face off against our advanced AI in the ultimate game of Xs and Os. Can you find the winning pattern before the AI does?
instructions: Simply click on any empty grid square to place your mark. The first player to get three in a row (horizontally, vertically, or diagonally) wins the match.

title: Memory Match
description: Sharpen your focus! Flip tiles to find matching pairs in this colorful pixel-art memory game. A perfect workout for your brain and a fun casual experience.
instructions: Click on any tile to flip it. Try to remember the image and its position. Then, flip another tile to find its pair. Match all tiles to clear the level!

title: Space Invaders
description: Defend Earth from the celestial swarm! Pilot your orbital ship and blast descending waves of alien invaders in this pixel-perfect recreation of the arcade legend.
instructions: Use Left/Right Arrows or touch controls to move your ship. Press Space or the Fire button to shoot. Use the bunkers for cover, but remember they are destructible!

title: Hextris
description: A geometric puzzle odyssey. Rotate the central hexagon to catch falling colored blocks. Match three or more of the same color to clear them before they reach the boundary.
instructions: Use Left and Right arrow keys to rotate the central hexagon. Match 3 or more blocks of the same color to clear them and prevent the stack from growing outward.

title: Connect Four
description: Strategy in gravity. Drop your colored discs into the vertical grid and be the first to connect four in a row. A simple concept with deep tactical gameplay.
instructions: Click on any column to drop your disc into the lowest available slot. Your goal is to be the first player to form a horizontal, vertical, or diagonal line of four discs.

title: Sudoku
description: The definitive numeric logic challenge. Fill the 9x9 grid so that every row, column, and 3x3 subgrid contains all digits from 1 to 9 without repetition.
instructions: Click a cell to select it and type a number (1-9). Every horizontal row, vertical column, and 3x3 square must contain each number exactly once. No guessing required!

title: Checkers
description: Classic tactical board game. Leap over your opponent's pieces to capture them and reach the far end to crown your kings. A timeless battle of strategy.
instructions: Click on a piece to select it, then click an adjacent diagonal square to move. Jump over an opponent's piece to capture it. Reach the opposite side to promote your piece!
